_note: Tier 2 batch w13, July to October 2023: the earliest material in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told that the covenant made with the settlers who came for religious freedom is honoured, and to look at judgment.
mentions.quote: I honor the covenant that I made with th with those settlers
mentions.falsify_match: America spared in a judgment that falls elsewhere.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no threshold given.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer recalling the singers going out before the armies, with God said to be obligated to keep his covenants.
mentions.quote: the singers went forth in front of the armies
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer citing scripture.

mentions.claim_text: A camaraderie and patriotism over America like the one after September 11th, which he believes is coming again.
mentions.quote: there was a real camarad a a patriotism that happened over America
mentions.falsify_match: A surge of national unity of that kind.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is heavy on his heart to pray for Israel at war and that he will bring some of his older words.
mentions.quote: it's heavy on my heart to pray for Israel
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a preamble.

mentions.claim_text: An announcement the day before that a body of men would come out of Syria in a single file line.
mentions.quote: a bunch of men are going to come out of Syria
mentions.falsify_match: A force moving out of Syria against Israel.

mentions.claim_text: It will be seen everywhere and there will be no doubt that there is a God over Israel.
mentions.quote: there will be no doubt that there is a God that is over Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A publicly visible event read worldwide as divine intervention for Israel.

mentions.claim_text: The birthing pains keep getting darker and stronger in these last days, and they are being seen now.
mentions.quote: the birthing ples are going to come High stronger and stronger
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intensification with no measure.

mentions.claim_text: He cites the instruction to watch the fig tree in the last days before playing a video.
mentions.quote: the Bible says watch the fig tree in these last days
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a scriptural instruction.

mentions.claim_text: Because America betrayed Israel and stood by, an opening was made for China to come and get us.
mentions.quote: we betrayed R uh uh Israel we opened an attack for China
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese attack on the United States.

mentions.claim_text: Honolulu annihilated with missiles, buildings on fire and things being shot down.
mentions.quote: the Honolulu Hawaii and it was just being annihilate
mentions.falsify_match: A missile attack on Hawaii.

mentions.claim_text: Iran devising a plan in communication with Syria and sending things there secretly, with men coming out of Syria.
mentions.quote: Iran devising a plan and they were communicating with Syria
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian materiel routed through Syria against Israel.

mentions.claim_text: Men out of Syria like ants in single file lines all going at Israel, with a great war breaking out.
mentions.quote: men coming out of Syria that look like ants
mentions.falsify_match: A ground invasion of Israel from Syria.

mentions.claim_text: This is a major ordeal rather than a few rockets, becoming an all-out war, with them marching out of Syria.
mentions.quote: this isn't just a couple Rockets shooting in
mentions.falsify_match: A general war on the northern front.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for divine protection over their land, binding the enemy and commanding it to cease and desist.
mentions.quote: we command you to cease and desist
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer for protection.

mentions.claim_text: His attention is drawn repeatedly to the water and to the coves in past visions.
mentions.quote: look at the water look at the Cove
mentions.falsify_match: An event at a named cove.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no cove is named here.

mentions.claim_text: Three times in a week the Lord spoke to him about the American electric grid and told him to pray over it.
mentions.quote: for three times now the Lord has spoken to me about the the electric grid
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on the American grid.

mentions.claim_text: A plot against America involving major cities and the power grid, with no timeframe given.
mentions.quote: a plot against America and about the power grid
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated attack on the grid in several cities.

mentions.claim_text: The area covered runs from Canada to Mexico and from the Atlantic to the Pacific, which he says he does not want to overstate.
mentions.quote: way up to Canada to Mexico from from the Atlantic to the Pacific
mentions.falsify_match: A continental outage.

mentions.claim_text: He assumed it concerned Oklahoma, with all the power going out and the water going bad.
mentions.quote: all the power is going to go out and the water
mentions.falsify_match: A combined power and water failure in Oklahoma.

mentions.claim_text: Petrol at seven or eight dollars a gallon as a nationwide average, with California already charging that.
mentions.quote: it' be six seven eight bucks a gallon
mentions.falsify_match: A national average petrol price of seven to eight dollars.

mentions.claim_text: Great things starting to happen on the war front, with a major draft coming as he was warned.
mentions.quote: a major draft coming
mentions.falsify_match: Conscription reintroduced.

mentions.claim_text: The area around Warsaw and Belarus named, with the president saying they wanted to lend support.
mentions.quote: I believe it was around Warsaw area and um bellarus area
mentions.falsify_match: The war reaching Poland and Belarus.

mentions.claim_text: If America goes along with dividing Jerusalem it brings a curse, because those who bless Israel are blessed.
mentions.quote: we divide Jerusalem that he would div the which would cause a curse
mentions.falsify_match: America backing a partition and suffering for it.
mentions.falsify_miss: America backs one with no consequence.

mentions.claim_text: Tumbleweeds and the stock market, empty grocery shelves, and 1,800 people from Texarkana to Tulsa.
mentions.quote: I saw the shelves being empty on the grocery store
mentions.falsify_match: A disaster on that line with casualties of about that number.

mentions.claim_text: Watch the euro, which he calls a very significant domino, with trouble coming for it.
mentions.quote: watch the Euro it's a very significant Domino
mentions.falsify_match: A euro crisis.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer with a guest that the president's eyes be sound and strong and that he stand against the enemy's forces.
mentions.quote: eyes that they give the president shall be sound and strong
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer for a leader.

mentions.claim_text: They wait to see how the Lord will move and say it is good simply to seek him.
mentions.quote: we're waiting to see how the Lord is going to move us
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a pause in a prayer meeting.

mentions.claim_text: He notes thousands of viewers in Africa, Europe and Asia, and that the instruction differs for everybody.
mentions.quote: I have thousands of people in Africa thousands of people in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an audience note.

mentions.claim_text: He answers the objection that 350 million is the whole US population by saying the figure is worldwide.
mentions.quote: I talked to you about the 350 million worldwide
mentions.falsify_match: A worldwide death toll approaching that number.

mentions.claim_text: God is not angry and not beating people about the head, and he says people will call this a great something.
mentions.quote: God is not mad at us
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a doctrinal statement.

mentions.claim_text: The culture of America and of the world has decayed and become a godless people.
mentions.quote: the decay of the culture of America has happened
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a judgment about culture.

mentions.claim_text: The 350 million is worldwide and separately 30 million over the United States, which he calls catastrophic.
mentions.quote: he showed me the 30 30 million over the United States
mentions.falsify_match: An American death toll near 30 million.

mentions.claim_text: A viewer in Australia reports banks refusing cash withdrawals, branches closing and rural ATMs disappearing.
mentions.quote: banks aren't allowing people to get it cash out
mentions.falsify_match: Cash access withdrawn across Australian banking.

mentions.claim_text: He was told this would not be a bad year, that interest rates would go up, and about the war in Ukraine.
mentions.quote: this is not going to be a bad year
mentions.falsify_match: A year widely read as good, with rates rising.
mentions.falsify_miss: A bad year, or rates falling.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not feel anything about Taiwan, though he prays and intercedes over it.
mentions.quote: people ask me about Taiwan and all that, I don't feel anything
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an absence of impression, though worth keeping beside the later Taiwan material.

mentions.claim_text: Great numbers of people coming to the central parts of America because of revival, desperate at what is coming.
mentions.quote: They come to the central parts of America
mentions.falsify_match: Mass relocation into the central states.

mentions.claim_text: If he tells you to help the homeless, do it with all your might, following the voice of the Lord for yourself.
mentions.quote: then do it with all your might
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: A ten dollar seed given with a request for a creative idea, on the Deuteronomy 28 promise.
mentions.quote: give me a creat
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a private outcome.

mentions.claim_text: Asked whether a current scare is the 350 million he saw, he says no and puts it years down the road.
mentions.quote: is this the 350 million that I saw no
mentions.falsify_match: The event arriving years later rather than then.
mentions.falsify_miss: It arrives immediately or not at all.

mentions.claim_text: Relocation is uncomfortable and takes pressure, and it is for what is coming a couple of years from now.
mentions.quote: in this relocating it's uncomfortable
mentions.time_phrase: a couple of years from now
mentions.falsify_match: A crisis prompting relocation within a few years.

mentions.claim_text: People in the blue states will relocate to the central part of America and to Florida, into the red states.
mentions.quote: they will move to the central part of America and to Florida
mentions.falsify_match: Net migration from blue to red states accelerating.

mentions.claim_text: He tells listeners to look at where a ministry is helping and how blessed it is before giving.
mentions.quote: where are they helping and how blessed are they
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: giving advice.

mentions.claim_text: Sowing into a ministry that serves Jewish people brings the blessing, because those who curse Israel are cursed.
mentions.quote: curse Israel will be cursed the Bible says that
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private outcomes from giving.

mentions.claim_text: He has known about the 24th for a while and was told it would be part of the first domino when it came.
mentions.quote: it would be part of the first Domino when the 24th came
mentions.falsify_match: An event of lasting significance dated to 24 August 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing of consequence on that date.

mentions.claim_text: Nations announced their accession and the Saudi crown prince said he would put his boot down on America.
mentions.quote: I'm gonna put my boot down on America
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi acting against American interests in the bloc.

mentions.claim_text: The only thing that will save America is an awakening and a mighty move of the Spirit.
mentions.quote: the only thing that's ever going to save America is an Awakening
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a doctrinal statement.

mentions.claim_text: A well known old man, a man in Asia and a man in South America, all of whom he says talk directly to Satan.
mentions.quote: there's a man in Asia and I saw a man down in in South America
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a spiritual characterisation of unnamed people.

mentions.claim_text: A woman pulled up with a mower on a trailer and told him the Lord had spoken to her in her yard the night before.
mentions.quote: the Lord spoke to me in my yard uh last night
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: another person's account.

mentions.claim_text: He describes being told to give away a watch he did not want to part with.
mentions.quote: I want you to give a watch away
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a private instruction.

mentions.claim_text: A great move of God about to pour out on the southern border, through Texas and through Mexico.
mentions.quote: a great move of God is about to pour out even on the southern border
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival along the southern border.

mentions.claim_text: A grace explosion about to happen, with two men seen standing in the back row because of the revivals coming.
mentions.quote: it will be a Grace explosion
mentions.falsify_match: A revival wave of the kind described.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no threshold for grace.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will be on the side of blessing Israel, citing the promise of blessing and cursing.
mentions.quote: I'm going to be on the side of the blessing
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement of his own position.

mentions.claim_text: A financial push like a tidal wave of blessing, compared to Israel taking the gold and silver out of Egypt.
mentions.quote: a financial push of a tidal wave of blessing
mentions.falsify_match: A visible transfer of wealth to the church.

mentions.claim_text: Gold going up in value as the dollar weakens, with the timing deliberately withheld.
mentions.quote: I saw gold going up in value when the dollar is weakened
mentions.falsify_match: Gold rising sharply against a weakening dollar.

mentions.claim_text: Saudi Arabia goes against the United States, pumping oil to cause a shortage, working with Russia.
mentions.quote: Arabia is going to go against the United States
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi and Russian action producing an oil shortage against American interests.
